label: Malnutrition, contaminated water, and post-infectious neuropathies: lessons from the Guillain-Barré syndrome outbreak in Gaza.
summary: The cases of malnutrition, water insecurity, and the collapse of the health system, turning into a humanitarian crisis, have been illustrated by the 2025 outbreak of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) in Gaza, which is a form of treatable post-infectious neuropathy. Toward the end of August 2025, there were reports of over 90 cases and at least 10 deaths due to shortages of intravenous immunoglobulin, plasma-exchange filters, and ventilators.
